channel.title: Empowered Vote changelog
channel.description: What changed on Empowered Vote, every Tuesday and Friday.

item.title: Treasury Tracker: Treasury Tracker has a new Payments view, where you can read the individual payments a city made to vendors, straight from its check register. Los Angeles, Plano and West Hollywood also gained earlier years.
item.description: Treasury Tracker has a new Payments view, where you can read the individual payments a city made to vendors, straight from its check register. Los Angeles, Plano and West Hollywood also gained earlier years. https://treasurytracker.empowered.vote

item.title: Essentials: Essentials now covers Reno and Washoe County, our first local governments in northern Nevada.
item.description: Essentials now covers Reno and Washoe County, our first local governments in northern Nevada. https://essentials.empowered.vote

item.title: Compass: For several days, Compass couldn't load your saved answers if you were signed in. That's fixed.
item.description: For several days, Compass couldn't load your saved answers if you were signed in. That's fixed. https://compass.empowered.vote

item.title: Platform-wide: You can now add your address with a basic account. We keep only your voting districts, never the street address itself.
item.description: You can now add your address with a basic account. We keep only your voting districts, never the street address itself.

item.title: Security and privacy: We fixed a security warning on our backend database.
item.description: We fixed a security warning on our backend database.

item.title: By the numbers: Essentials now has profiles for more than 14,000 officials and candidates, up by more than 320 since Friday. Civic Trivia's live questions are up 10.
item.description: Essentials now has profiles for more than 14,000 officials and candidates, up by more than 320 since Friday. Civic Trivia's live questions are up 10. https://empowered.vote/briefing/2026-11-10

item.title: Not launched yet: We also made progress on Civic Spaces, Empowered Listening, Read & Rank and the next season of Compass.
item.description: We also made progress on Civic Spaces, Empowered Listening, Read & Rank and the next season of Compass. https://empowered.vote/maps/purpose-map.html
